title: 第19章 力压紫霄宗天才九十连胜第20章 九十七层少年叶皇
content_zh:
林玄继续攀登，一波三十连胜下来，打到了第九十层。
总连胜场次达到了惊人的九十场！
“九十连胜，这可是五千年未有的壮举啊！”
“这小子到底是何方妖孽，天柱峰一带的武道势力，似乎培养不出这样的人物？”
玄副阁主无比激动。
这样的妖孽要是招进观玄阁，至少也是真传弟子的份量。
需要长老亲传、重点培养，趁手的兵器、法宝自不用说，丹药绝对管够！
而挑战到此，也让林玄明白了外界的武道状况。
真是人外有人，天外有天！
在天玄宗里，玄气境十层乃至巅峰的天才，也没超出过六象之力。
那已经比普通武者强出好多倍！
而在这里，这样的人物比比皆是，甚至连前八十名都很难进入。
差距之大，令人震惊！
战天塔九十层，距离战天塔的巅峰，只差九层！
“已经九十连胜了！他还能走多远，能达到最后那一层吗？”
大厅中的灵镜法阵前，玄副阁主嗓子有些发干，心头巨浪涌动。
哪怕林玄现在止步，也创下了五千年未有之壮举。
今天，他真的要见证奇迹了！
战天塔内，长老的声音再次响起。
“林玄，连续鏖战消耗极大，你不必急于上行，可以原地休息一刻钟。

如果需要丹药可以提出申请，从你的连胜奖励中提前兑付。
当然，提前兑付的丹药，价格会比正常略高，毕竟这属于额外补给，变相作弊。”
战天塔长老注意到林玄从始至终都不曾服用丹药，猜测他可能没有补给，出于善意做出提醒。
“不必了。”林玄拒绝了对方。
连胜九十场，奖励已经累积到了相当丰厚的地步。
现在兑付，并不需要花费灵币。
但到目前为止，他只动用了七成左右的力量，消耗不大，不需要提前兑付奖励。
“好吧，接下来的九层，个个都是万年以来的超级天才，你要小心了，若扛不住立即认输，你还有大好前程，切莫为了一时之勇损伤根基、消耗了潜力。”
长老的声音里，传出几分关切。
如此天才，五千年未有，观玄阁高层必定全力招揽。
林玄很可能成为观玄阁的一员，将来甚至会成为长老，有必要提前交好。
content_en:
Lin Xuan continued to climb, winning a wave of thirty consecutive victories, and reached the ninetieth floor.
The total winning streak reached an astonishing ninety games!
"Ninety consecutive victories, this is a feat that has not been seen in five thousand years!"
"What kind of monster is this kid? It seems that the martial arts forces in the Tianzhu Peak area cannot cultivate such a person?"
Deputy Pavilion Master Xuan was extremely excited.
If such a monster were recruited into Guanxuan Pavilion, he would at least have the weight of a true disciple.
It needs to be personally taught by the elders and focused on training. Not to mention the weapons and magic weapons at hand, the elixirs will definitely be enough!
This challenge also made Lin Xuan understand the martial arts situation in the outside world.
It’s true that there are people outside the world, and there is a sky outside the world!
In the Tianxuan Sect, even the geniuses at the tenth level or even the peak of the Xuanqi Realm have not surpassed the power of the Six Symbols.
That is already many times stronger than ordinary warriors!
But here, such characters abound, and it is difficult to even enter the top eighty.
The difference is so huge it’s shocking!
The ninetieth floor of the Battle Sky Tower is only nine floors away from the peak of the Battle Sky Tower!
"It's been ninety consecutive victories! How far can he go? Can he reach the last level?"
In front of the Spiritual Mirror Array in the hall, Deputy Pavilion Master Xuan's throat felt a little dry and his heart was filled with huge waves.
Even if Lin Xuan stops now, he has achieved a feat that has not been seen in five thousand years.
Today, he is really going to witness a miracle!
In the Battle Tower, the elder's voice sounded again.
"Lin Xuan, continuous fierce fighting consumes a lot of energy. You don't have to rush up. You can rest where you are for a quarter of an hour.
If you need elixirs, you can apply for them and redeem them in advance from your winning streak rewards.
Of course, the price of the elixir paid in advance will be slightly higher than normal. After all, this is an additional supply and is cheating in disguise. "
The elder of Zhan Tian Pagoda noticed that Lin Xuan never took any pills from beginning to end, and guessed that he might not have supplies, so he reminded him out of goodwill.
"No need." Lin Xuan rejected the other party.
After winning ninety games in a row, the rewards have been accumulated to a very generous level.
There is no need to spend spiritual coins to redeem it now.
But so far, he has only used about 70% of his power, which means he does not consume much and does not need to redeem the rewards in advance.
"Okay, the next nine levels are all super geniuses who have been around for thousands of years. You have to be careful. If you can't bear it, give up immediately. You still have a bright future. Don't damage your foundation and consume your potential just for a moment of bravery."
There was some concern in the elder's voice.
Such a genius has not been seen in five thousand years, and the senior officials of Guanxuan Pavilion will definitely try their best to recruit him.
Lin Xuan is likely to become a member of Guanxuan Pavilion and even become an elder in the future, so it is necessary to make friends in advance.
